# Data dictionary

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `aero/source_tables/` | Exact source breakpoints and constant derivatives |
| `aero/grids/static_grid_zero_controls.csv` | Shared zero-control six-axis grid |
| `aero/grids/symmetric_stabilator_grid.csv` | Full coefficients and increments versus pitch-control deflection |
| `aero/grids/differential_stabilator_grid.csv` | Full coefficients and increments versus roll-control deflection |
| `aero/grids/rudder_grid.csv` | Full coefficients and increments versus rudder deflection |
| `aero/grids/combined_controls_sample.csv` | Smaller combined-control interaction sample generated by superposition |
| `aero/evaluator.py` | Standalone coefficient evaluator |
| `aero/validity_envelope.csv` | Computational support and confidence limits |
| `controls/` | Control mapping, clips, lag, and missing rate/delay data |
| `geometry/reference_geometry.csv` | Sref, span, chord, AERORP, CG and approximate dimensions |
| `mass/source_native_full_throttle_mass_cg_inertia_schedule.csv` | Derived source-native mass-property history |
| `mass/nasa_anchor_mass_properties.csv` | Independent NASA launch/burnout anchors |
| `propulsion/source_native_throttle_map.csv` | Simplified flow/Isp/nozzle-derived map |
| `propulsion/source_native_full_throttle_step_history.csv` | Ideal step ignition/shutdown history |
| `propulsion/nasa_operational_envelope.csv` | Independent NASA thrust and duration anchors |
| `environment/us_standard_atmosphere_1976.csv` | Standard atmosphere with explicit zero-wind placeholder |
| `coverage_matrix.csv` | Requirement-by-requirement status |
| `candidate_comparison.csv` | Why X-15 was selected over other public candidates |
| `checks/validation_report.json` | Machine-generated consistency checks |
